title: Tense Sequence with Subjunctive in the Past

sections.content:
When the governing verb in the main clause is in a past tense (indefinido, imperfecto, pluscuamperfecto), the subordinate subjunctive verb shifts into the **imperfect subjunctive** (*-ra / -se*):

• Present frame: *Quiero que vengas.* (Present subjunctive)
• Past frame: *Quería que vinieras.* (Imperfect subjunctive)
• Indefinido frame: *Me pidió que le ayudara.* (Imperfect subjunctive)
• Condition: *Me encantaría que vinieras.* (Conditional triggers imperfect subjunctive).

items.spanish: Mis padres querían que yo estudiara medicina.
items.english: My parents wanted me to study medicine.

items.spanish: El médico me recomendó que guardara reposo.
items.english: The doctor recommended that I get some rest.

items.spanish: Me alegré mucho de que estuvieras en la ceremonia.
items.english: I was very glad that you were at the ceremony.

sections.content: Never mix a past main verb with a present subjunctive: say *Quería que viniera*, never *Quería que venga*.
